artifact_observations.location: Performer's right hand gripping the microphone stand
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers appear slightly fused and lack distinct knuckle definition, blending into the stand and each other. This is a common AI artifact in complex hand-object interactions.

The microphone head appears to melt into the stand shaft. The geometry is nonsensical; it lacks a clear clip or mounting mechanism, appearing as a blob of metal/plastic rather than a functional object.

While some blur is expected from motion or depth of field, the texture of the feathers lacks individual strand definition and appears smudged/painted, typical of generative models struggling with fine, chaotic textures.
